title: Generate zero-correction uncalibrated output
description: Allow deterministic PDF preparation without a compatible profile only after software validation, using exactly zero correction and persistent uncalibrated disclosure.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing or incompatible profile paths offer an explicit uncalibrated action only when all software validations pass
Uncalibrated scene/PDF inputs apply exactly 0 mm x and 0 mm y translation and no other profile correction
The uncalibrated status is visible before generation and in resulting preparation details
Generated bytes contain no alignment, suitable-setup, calibrated, physically verified, or printing-success claim

steps.details: Add a preparation mode that requires successful software validation and explicitly fixes all correction values to zero.
Strip or reject profile correction inputs whenever no compatible profile is authorized, including restored stale state.
Present a keyboard-operable uncalibrated choice with text explaining zero correction and absent physical claims before generation and in details.
Test missing/incompatible profile flows, software-validation refusal, exact zero translation, deterministic bytes/hash, and prohibited-claim absence.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; add the zero-correction mode and focused artifact assertions only.
Uncalibrated means zero correction, not approximate calibration.
PDF generation is file preparation only and must not imply printer control or physical output.
